title: Thread pool with futures, draining shutdown and wait_idle
prompt: Implement a header-only `class ThreadPool` in the global namespace.

- `template <class F, class... Args> auto submit(F&& f, Args&&... args) -> std::future<std::invoke_result_t<F, Args...>>` enqueues `f(args...)` and returns a future for its result. Exceptions thrown by the task must propagate through the future. Must work with move-only callables, move-only arguments and void-returning callables.
- `void wait_idle()` blocks until the queue is empty and no task is running.
- The destructor runs every task that was already submitted, then joins all threads.
- Tasks may call submit() on the same pool (they will not block waiting for the resulting future).
- The pool is neither copyable nor movable.
